Ben — thanks for the ping. Procurement can accept alternate documentation in place of an automated TIN match, but we need one of the following:

1) Notarized W-9 (completed & signed) OR
2) Bank letter on official letterhead confirming EIN and payment account for the vendor OR
3) A signed employer EIN confirmation letter from an officer (on company letterhead) + proof of commercial activity (invoice + contract).

Regarding delegated signer rotation: we do not require a single persistent signer on file, but we do require an authorization document that:
- Names the roles authorized to sign (e.g., CFO, VP Finance, Payroll Director) OR
- Provides a standing power-of-attorney-type statement with dates and a company stamp.

If the vendor can provide (1) or (2) plus a short "Delegated Signer Authorization" doc (DocuSign or stamped PDF) we'll be comfortable issuing a provisional PO for 30 days. After verification completes we’ll convert it to a production PO.

I'll attach the acceptable-docs.pdf checklist for their reference.

-Laura Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
